title: Design System: S1 · Полигон эвакуации НПЗ

title.purpose: One h1 per screen, a noun.

id.purpose: Run IDs, seeds, hashes, the sim clock only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Drawer, modal, menu, toast, tour, open mobile sidebar only.

shadows.name: float-dark
shadows.purpose: Same overlays in the dark theme.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes a drawer; grids stack.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: KPI 2-up, segments wrap, tables scroll in frame.

rules: Colour on data, state and the cloud; chrome stays neutral.
One strategy keeps one colour across every chart and legend.
The minute strip is the shared timeline for player, journal and trainer.
Every report carries the limitations block.
